project_name: Harbor Freight Tools, 819 Crossroads Plaza, Mount Pleasant PA
gc: Marco Contractors (Jayne Baxter; job key hft8841)
scope_of_work_and_exclusions: DEMOLITION SCOPE OF WORK
1. Remove all existing floor finishes throughout the HFT space, +/-18,060 SF (Plan Note 215, Gen. Note 16)
2. Remove fixtures (fixed or free-standing) and all abandoned equipment throughout the HFT space (Plan Notes 202, 203)
3. Remove light fixtures completely throughout the HFT space (Plan Note 212)
4. Remove abandoned electrical equipment not to be re-used incl. junction boxes, conduit and wiring, and unused wires and hangers, back to the nearest junction box (Plan Note 205, A2.0)
5. Remove exposed metal studs completely, +/-74 LF (+/-58'-8" and +/-14'-10") (Plan Note 207)
6. Remove existing gyp. bd. wall and associated furring (Plan Note 209)
7. Remove (2) existing overhead doors and frames and (1) hollow metal door and frame (Plan Notes 218, 221, 240)
8. Remove existing storefront doors and storefront system at new bi-parting entry, +/-12'-0" W x 10'-0" H, and portion of storefront +/-5'-2" W; knee wall to remain (Plan Notes 211, 219)
9. Remove existing canopy and all associated attachments at north door (Plan Note 247)
10. Remove existing signage (Plan Note 223)
11. Remove existing receiving platform, rail, canopy, ramp and all associated attachments, +/-871 SF (Plan Note 208)
12. Remove asphalt for new concrete pad and receiving enclosure, +/-911 SF, and existing sloped asphalt, +/-176 SF (Plan Notes 224, 227)
13. Remove concrete walk for new concrete ramp, frost slab, sidewalk and egress ramp, +/-916 SF (Plan Notes 225, 226, 228, 234)
14. Remove existing bollards completely, 4 EA (Plan Note 246)
15. Remove all debris from site and legally dispose; leave broom clean (Gen. Notes 2, 5, 21)
ALTERNATES

Alt #1: Cut and remove CMU to expand OH door opening to 8'-0" x 10'-0", masonry at bi-parting entry, (2) new 3'-4" x 7'-4" HM door openings, and remove 8" CMU infill, +/-150 SF (Plan Notes 218, 219, 220, 236)
Alt #2: Sawcut and remove slab for plumbing trench, approx. 370 SF (Plan Note 217)
Alt #3: Sawcut asphalt and concrete walk at site removal limits, +/-280 LF (Plan Notes 224-228, 234)
Alt #4: Cut out remaining floor outlets, drains and holes (allowance 10 EA) and sawcut/remove interior concrete curb +/-12 LF (Plan Notes 216, 249)
Alt #5: Grind / remove mastic after flooring removal (Plan Note 215)
EXCLUSIONS
- Roofing, roof deck openings and capped curb removal at new RTUs (Plan Notes 213, 214) - by landlord's roofing contractor / mechanical contractor

- Mechanical, plumbing, fire protection and electrical demolition by those trades (Gen. Notes 13, 14; M1.0, P1.0, E-sheets), except light fixtures and abandoned electrical back to the nearest junction box
- Removal of conduit and wiring beyond the nearest junction box or back to panel/source; utility disconnects, caps and off-hours shutdowns

- All patching, repair and prep: masonry wall patch, slab patch and prep for new finishes, concrete infill, opening prep for new masonry infill, demising wall prep, column paint prep (Plan Notes 201, 206-209, 211, 215-221, 236, 247, 249)

- Shoring included is limited to non-load-bearing masonry; load-bearing wall shoring, shoring design, structural engineering and stamped drawings excluded. NOTE: D1.0 states GC shoring must be in the bid with no exclusions
- Furnishing and installing lintels, bearing plates, jamb reinforcement and grouting; new masonry infill
- Excavation for new ramps, frost slab and sidewalks beyond removal of existing paving; private utility locates; slab X-ray / GPR scanning (Gen. Note 20)
- Downspout repair / rework (Plan Notes 245, 248); asphalt patching, seal coat and striping
- Hazardous materials survey and abatement (Gen. Note 6)
- Bid assumes landlord scope complete prior to DDD mobilization; anything incomplete is by change order
- Terms: plans only, zero retainage, net 30, price valid 90 days; additional mobilization $3,250
OPEN ITEMS TO CONFIRM
- Bid date was 10/27/26 10:00 AM ET - confirm Marco will still accept a late number
- Travel job (~900 mi from Lake City): lodging & per diem included (toggle on Inputs); mobilization terms may need to exceed the standard $3,250
- Existing floor finish type and light fixture count not shown - verify at walk; receiving platform construction not detailed
- PA dumpster and equipment rates are placeholders - confirm locally
